proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ t p
  have hG : ∀ i j k : Fin 3, i ≠ j → i ≠ k → j ≠ k →
      t.centroid = AffineMap.lineMap (t.points i) (midpoint ℝ (t.points j) (t.points k)) (2 / 3 : ℝ) := by
    intro i j k hij hik hjk
    have hsum : ∀ f : Fin 3 → V, ∑ l, f l = f i + f j + f k := by
      intro f
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> fin_cases k <;> simp_all <;> abel
    rw [t.centroid_eq_smul_sum_vsub_vadd i, hsum, AffineMap.lineMap_apply, midpoint_vsub]
    congr 1
    simp only [vsub_self, invOf_eq_inv]
    norm_num
    module
  refine ⟨fun i j k hij hik hjk => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · rw [hG i j k hij hik hjk]
    exact AffineMap.lineMap_mem_affineSpan_pair _ _ _
  · refine t.eq_centroid_of_forall_mem_median (hn := by norm_num) fun i => ?_
    obtain ⟨j, k, hij, hik, hjk⟩ : ∃ j k : Fin 3, i ≠ j ∧ i ≠ k ∧ j ≠ k := by decide +revert
    rw [t.median_eq_line_point_centroid]
    refine affineSpan_pair_le_of_mem_of_mem (left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ _ _) ?_ (h i j k hij hik hjk)
    have hM : midpoint ℝ (t.points j) (t.points k) = AffineMap.lineMap (t.points i) t.centroid (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by
      rw [hG i j k hij hik hjk, AffineMap.lineMap_apply, AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub, smul_smul]
      norm_num
    rw [hM]
    exact AffineMap.lineMap_mem_affineSpan_pair _ _ _
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (t : Affine.Triangle ℝ P) (p : P), (∀ i j k : Fin 3, i ≠ j → i ≠ k → j ≠ k → t.centroid ∈ line[ℝ, t.points i, midpoint ℝ (t.points j) (t.points k)]) ∧ ((∀ i j k : Fin 3, i ≠ j → i ≠ k → j ≠ k → p ∈ line[ℝ, t.points i, midpoint ℝ (t.points j) (t.points k)]) → p = t.centroid)
